news.title: b11552
news.dek:
server: leave a busy slot untouched when a request pins it ( #30295 ) 
 A request asking for a busy id_slot still ran the prompt cache update 
on that slot before being deferred. When the RAM cache held a better 
match, it was loaded into the slot while another request was still
news.aiSummary: The update fixes a bug where a request targeting a busy ID slot would incorrectly trigger a prompt cache update before being deferred. This prevented the RAM cache from loading a better match into the slot while another request was still active.

news.title: Microsoft CEO Nadella Calls for ‘Emergency Brake’ on Advanced AI
news.dek: Microsoft Corp. Chief Executive Officer Satya Nadella said companies should treat powerful artificial intelligence models as potential insider threats, assume they could be compromised and create an “emergency brake” system to prevent agentic models from going rogue.
news.aiSummary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella advised that companies should view powerful AI models as potential insider threats that could be compromised. He recommended implementing an 'emergency brake' system to prevent agentic models from going rogue.
